title: Advanced Imaging: Knee MRI Without Contrast
text:
Knee MRI without contrast (PRC-160) is covered for members with musculoskeletal or injury diagnoses affecting the knee, when conservative measures have been documented or a traumatic injury is present. Notes should describe the symptoms such as pain, swelling or instability, the functional limitation, and why imaging will change management.

Advanced imaging billed with a diagnosis unrelated to the musculoskeletal system is not payable. The auto-approval limit for this procedure is applied to each claim.
